app.name: PFF ProMaster
app.tagline: Event photography management, culling, editing and delivery
app.noBackend: Core unavailable: the interface is running outside the desktop app.

home.noRecent: No projects yet. Create the first one with “New project”.
home.unavailable: Folder not found (disk disconnected or project moved)
home.forgetHint: Removes the project from the recent list. No files are deleted.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.name: Event name
newProject.invalidDate: Invalid date. Use the DD/MM/YYYY format.
newProject.originalsHint: Destination for photos when you choose “Copy to originals folder” on import. Leave empty to keep files where they are.
newProject.workPlaceholder: Folder where the project will be created
newProject.workHint: Must be on a local disk (internal or external), not a network share.
newProject.required: Enter the event name and the working folder.

import.folderHint: Import one or more folders, including subfolders
import.title: Import photos
import.referenceHint: Files are not copied or modified; the project stores their location.
import.copyHint: Copies to {{path}}, organised by camera, with copy verification. Source files are left untouched.
import.copyUnavailable: Unavailable: the project has no originals folder.
import.formatsNote: Imports JPEG, PNG, TIFF/BigTIFF, WebP, JPEG XL, JPEG 2000, PSD/PSB (composite), BMP, GIF, OpenEXR, HDR and camera RAW (LibRaw), plus HEIC/HEIF/AVIF on macOS and Windows. Unsupported, corrupted or codec-less files are listed in the report. Duplicates (same content) are skipped.
import.backup: Also copy to a backup disk
import.backupHint: ORIGINAL → Working and ORIGINAL → Backup, at the same time, verified.
import.verifyHint: Re-reads every copied file and compares its BLAKE3 with the original. Slower; recommended for cards.

report.title: Import finished
report.corruptHint: the format was recognised but the data is damaged or incomplete.
report.missingCodecHint: the format was recognised but there is no decoder on this platform (e.g. HEIC/AVIF outside macOS and Windows, or without the Microsoft Store extensions).
report.unsupportedHint: unknown format, or a file that is not a photo.

project.emptyTitle: No photos in this project yet
project.emptyHint: Import a folder or files, or drag them onto this window.
project.noMatches: No photos match the current filter.

grid.thumbFailed: Could not create the thumbnail. See the info panel.

info.none: Select a photo to see its information.
info.title: Information
info.applyToSelection_other: Rating applies to the {{count}} selected photos
info.unreadableTitle: This photo could not be read
info.unreadableText: The file appears to be corrupted or incomplete. The original was not modified.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.colors: Red / yellow / green / blue label (repeat to remove)
shortcuts.close: Back to grid / exit full screen
shortcuts.zoom: Zoom in / out (thumbnail size in grid)
shortcuts.compare: Compare side by side (selection or sequence)

error.io: Error reading or writing a file.
error.catalogTooNew: This project was created by a newer version of the app.
error.other: The operation could not be completed.
error.projectInUse: This project is already open in another window or instance of the app.
error.unavailable: The original is not accessible (disk disconnected or file missing).

label.bestHint: Recommended: the best of this moment (or one of the best).
label.alternativeHint: Almost as good as the best of this moment.
label.reviewHint: No serious flaws, but weaker: your call.
label.rejectHint: Suggested reject (out of focus, eyes closed…). Nothing is deleted.
label.duplicateHint: Near-identical copy of another photo (or the JPEG of a RAW+JPEG pair).
label.protectedHint: The analysis suggested rejecting it or marking it as a duplicate, but this photo is a favourite or has stars: your decision wins.

selection.title: Smart selection
selection.intro: Recommends the best of each moment (sharpness, exposure, faces, eyes). All on this computer; nothing is sent to the internet or deleted.
selection.noModels: Local AI models not found: technical analysis only (no faces or eyes).

modeHint.conservative: Keeps more photos per moment and only suggests rejecting obvious failures.
modeHint.strict: One photo per moment; suggests rejecting more.

selection.reanalyzeConfirm: Delete the analysis and start over? Your ratings are kept.
selection.local: Local analysis · recommendations only: the decision is always yours.

sequences.empty: No sequences yet. Analyse the photos in the sidebar (Smart selection).
sequences.compareHint: Compare the best side by side
sequences.acceptHint: Pick the BEST and reject the SUGGESTED REJECTS — only where you have not decided yet. Reversible; nothing is deleted.

compare.openHint: Compare 2–4 selected photos, or the sequence of the current photo
compare.title: Comparison
compare.hint: Synchronised zoom and pan · ← → switches pane · P/X/0–5 on the active pane
compare.swapHint: Swap for another photo from the same group
compare.needTwo: Select 2 to 4 photos (or one photo of a sequence) to compare.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.acceptHint: Apply the suggestion to this photo. Reversible.

summary.rawJpegPair: JPEG of the same RAW shot

reason.bestAvailableLowQuality: the best available, but low quality
reason.muchWorseThanBest: much worse than the best of the moment
reason.weakerThanBest: weaker than the best of the moment
reason.rawJpegPair: the RAW is kept as the main file

moments.title: Moments
moments.dropHint_one: Drop {{count}} photo on a moment (empty ones: “Show all”)
moments.dropHint_other: Drop {{count}} photos on a moment (empty ones: “Show all”)
moments.unclassifiedHint: Photos without enough confidence for a moment (nothing is forced).
moments.dragging_one: Dragging {{count}} photo — drop it on a moment
moments.dragging_other: Dragging {{count}} photos — drop them on a moment

clock.hint: Fix each camera's time and rebuild the timeline
clock.title: Sync cameras
clock.intro: Choose the camera with the correct time and enter the others' clock offset (e.g. Sony +3min42s = ahead). The photos' original time is not changed; the timeline, sequences and moments are rebuilt.
clock.noSuggestion: No suggestion: no similar photos taken by several cameras were found.

people.title: People
people.needRoles: First identify the people with these roles in “Manage people”.
people.name: Name
people.emptyView: No people yet. Analyse the photos (Smart selection).
people.privacy: Face data stays on this computer.
people.reclusterHint: Regroups automatic faces; identified people are kept.
people.ambiguousRoles: More than one person has the same role. Merge them in “Manage people” (select both → Merge) to search.

organization.title: Organisation
organization.showPerson: Show all photos of this person

develop.wbPickerHint: Click an area that should be neutral (grey or white) (W)
develop.detailNote: Sharpening and noise reduction show in the final render (when you release the control).
develop.copyNote: Geometry (crop, rotation) is not copied by default.
develop.autoStraightenNone: No reliable lines found to straighten.
develop.syncHint: Apply this photo's adjustments to the other selected photos
develop.clipboardEmpty: You have not copied settings yet.
develop.syncNeedSelection: Select the photos to sync in the grid.
develop.splitHint: Before/after side by side with a divider (drag)

retouch.note: Non-destructive fixes: eyes come from the local face detection; spots are searched on smooth areas.

develop.autoSyncHint: Every change made here is also applied to the other {{count}} selected photos (light, color, curves, detail, effects… — not crop, masks or retouching).
develop.autoSyncNeedSelection: Select several photos in the filmstrip (Cmd/Ctrl+click or Shift+click), including this one, to edit them all at once.
develop.uprightHint: Corrects perspective from the photo's lines (vanishing points), using the camera focal length.
develop.uprightNone: No reliable lines were found for this mode.
develop.guidesHint: Draw 2 to 4 lines over edges that should be vertical or horizontal ({{count}}/4). The correction shows when you finish.
develop.aspectToSelectionHint: Each photo gets its own crop, centred on faces (eyes on the upper third) or on its current composition.
develop.lensProfileNone: This photo's lens is not in the profile database (Lensfun), or the file does not name the lens.
develop.lensProfileApplied_one: Profile updated on {{count}} photo ({{missing}} without an available profile).
develop.lensProfileApplied_other: Profile updated on {{count}} photos ({{missing}} without an available profile).
develop.zoomHint: Zoom: double-click or Z toggles fit and 100%; mouse wheel zooms at the cursor; drag to pan

intensityHint.verySoft: Small corrections only; the original look barely changes
intensityHint.soft: Moderate corrections, without adding contrast or color
intensityHint.natural: Fixes exposure, white balance and tones while keeping the photo's mood
intensityHint.balanced: Full corrections plus a little more contrast, color and clarity
intensityHint.strong: Full corrections with stronger contrast, color and clarity
intensityHint.custom: Choose the strength and which adjustment groups are automatic

extrasHint.crop: Only for photos with people: improves framing without cutting faces (at most ~15 %)
extrasHint.redEye: Detects red (flash) pupils on the faces found and fixes them
extrasHint.dust: Looks for small round spots on smooth areas (sky, walls) and removes them

aiModes.whenNeeded: When there is a lot of noise

auto.aiMissing: AI Denoise model not found (scripts/prepare-models.py): only the fast noise reduction is used.
auto.aiSlow: AI Denoise is slow (about 3 s per megapixel on a 4-core computer).
auto.aiRecommended: High noise: AI Denoise gives a better result.
auto.runHint: Analyse this photo and adjust it automatically (can be undone)
auto.batchHint: Automatically edit the selected photos, in the background
auto.batchIntro: Each photo is analysed individually (exposure, white balance, tones, color, noise with the camera ISO, horizon, lens): the adjustments are not the same for all.
auto.nonDestructive: Originals are never changed. Each edit is kept in the photo's history and can be undone.

presets.applyHint: Apply a preset to the selection, a moment or the whole wedding
presets.name: Name
presets.componentsNote: Only the chosen components are saved and applied; the rest of each photo stays as it is. By default only the look (no exposure or white balance, which change from photo to photo).
presets.deleteNote: Photos where it was already applied do not change (each edit has its own recipe).
presets.xmpWarning: The Lightroom/Camera Raw values were interpreted by the PFF ProMaster engine. The names are similar but the engines are not: the look will not match Lightroom. Check the preset on one photo before using it in batch.
presets.cubeNote: Color LUT applied in sRGB at the end of processing, with trilinear interpolation (as in video editors). LUTs for log/HDR footage are refused.
presets.applyNote: Each photo keeps its exposure, white balance and crop (unless the preset includes them) and it can be undone in the history.

look.viewHint: Group by light, camera, scene, time, white balance and flash; sync with a reference
look.referenceHint: Click a photo to make it the reference (double-click opens it in the editor). Edit the reference, then sync the others.

sync.smart: Adjust each photo to the reference (smart)
sync.smartIntro: Each photo receives this photo's look and is adjusted until the result matches — the same values are not copied:

option.look: Look (tone, color, curve, toning, B&W, effects, LUT)

sync.smartNote: Measured on each photo's result; runs in the background and each one can be undone in the history. Skin tones need the analysis (faces).

masks.none: No masks. Create one to adjust only an area.
masks.name: Mask name
masks.emptyResult: No {{kind}} found in this photo (the mask is empty; you can paint with the brush).

hint.brush: Paint on the image. Esc ends.
hint.linear: Drag on the image: from the affected side to the unaffected side.

toolLabel.radial: Radial gradient: drag from the center
toolLabel.patch: Paint over the object to remove

retouch.healHint: Click a spot: it is replaced by a nearby area with light and color matched to the surroundings
retouch.cloneHint: Click: copies a nearby area as it is
retouch.objectHint: Paint over a small object: it is filled with a nearby area
retouch.note: Everything is stored as a recipe and can be changed or removed. Object removal copies a nearby area (it does not invent content): it works for small objects on simple backgrounds.

portrait.note: Subtle and only in each face's regions: smooths blemishes while keeping pores, never reshapes or changes features. Detect faces first; each control at 0 changes nothing.

export.title: Export
export.buttonHint: Export the selection or the visible photos
export.noSpace: Not enough space at the destination
export.saveRecipeHint: Save to the library (available in every project)
export.noMetadataFormat: This format does not store EXIF/XMP (only the colour profile).
export.linearNote: OpenEXR stores linear light (no gamma curve), with the primaries of the chosen space.
export.fillNote: Crops at the centre to the exact size (e.g. Instagram 4:5). The edit's crop is applied first.
export.creator: Author
export.pausedNoSpace: Paused: not enough space at the destination. Free some space and resume.

note.depth: bit depth adjusted to the format
note.space: colour space not supported by this format — sRGB used
note.jp2Lossless: Lossless JPEG 2000 only at 8 bits in this version (at 12/16 bits the reference OpenJPEG does not read it exactly) — 8 bits used; for lossless 16 bits use TIFF or PNG

unavailable.hevc: Unavailable: encoding HEIF/HEIC requires an HEVC encoder (x265, GPL licence and patents). Not included; use AVIF (the same HEIF container with AV1).
unavailable.dng: Unavailable in this version: a useful DNG needs the undeveloped sensor data and the camera colour matrices; not implemented yet.

gallery.title: Client gallery
gallery.replaceAsk: A gallery already exists in this folder. Replace it?
gallery.introHint: A message for the couple. Blank lines separate paragraphs.
gallery.heroHint: Pick a photo in the grid (it gets focus) and use "Use the focused photo". Without a hero, the top shows only the names.
gallery.favorites: Favourites (the client hearts photos and sends you the list)

protectionHint.pin: The photo list is encrypted (AES-GCM) and files have random names. A short PIN is a light barrier: use a password for more security. Anyone with the direct address of an image can open it.
protectionHint.password: The photo list is encrypted (AES-GCM, key derived from the password) and files have unguessable random names. Anyone with the direct address of an image can open it.

gallery.existsNote: already exists — will be replaced after you confirm
gallery.publishInfo: The gallery is a static folder: it opens directly on the computer and can be published as is on any host (Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, your own server…). Disable directory listing on the server.
gallery.providersInfo: Direct publishing to a service (S3, R2, B2, SFTP) is not available in this version: copy the folder to your hosting. The application contacts no service.
gallery.clientFavoritesInfo: Paste the list the client sent you from the gallery: those photos get the purple label.

problem.pin: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits
problem.password: The password must have at least 6 characters
problem.blocked: The destination folder exists and is not a Momento gallery
problem.exists: A gallery already exists in this folder
problem.heroHidden: The hero or cover photo is hidden or rejected — choose another

album.title: Album
album.emptyHint: No albums in this project yet. Create one and set the lab's format.
album.name: Name
album.cropHint: Drag the photo inside its frame to reframe (or Alt + drag)
album.autoHint: Analyses the final selection, moments, chronology, rating, orientation, people and relevance and builds a narrative: opening → preparation → ceremony → couple → family → reception → party → closing.
album.autoReplace: This replaces the photos on every spread.
album.autoResult: Used {{used}} of {{candidates}} photos · {{lowRes}} with insufficient resolution · {{dup}} repeated or bursts.
album.noErrors: No errors. Review the warnings before sending.
album.exportStarted: Album export added to the queue.

problem.pagesEven: The page count must be even.
problem.pagesMin: Fewer pages than the lab minimum.
problem.pagesMax: More pages than the lab maximum.
problem.margins: Invalid bleed, safe zone or gutter.

issue.unconfirmed: Bleed, safe zone and gutter are not confirmed. There are no universal values: confirm them with your lab.
issue.pageCount: The album has {{value}} laid-out pages, different from the specification.
issue.crowded: Too many photos on this spread ({{value}}).
issue.missing: Photo not found in the project.
issue.edgeNearTrim: Edge between trim and safe zone: extend to the bleed or pull back.
issue.faceCropped: Face cut by the framing — adjust the slot crop.

safety.title: Safety & backups
safety.unclean: The previous session did not close the project (crash, power cut or app killed). The catalogue was fully checked in {{ms}} ms: no data lost.
safety.tempRemoved_one: {{count}} temporary file from an interrupted write was removed.
safety.tempRemoved_other: {{count}} temporary files from interrupted writes were removed.
safety.restoredFrom: The catalogue was damaged and was restored from the version of {{when}}. The damaged catalogue was kept (never deleted). Changes made after that time are not in this version.
safety.availabilityHint: Disconnected external disks go offline: references are never deleted and come back automatically when the disk returns (checked every 30 s). Moved or renamed files are “missing”: use “Search a folder…”.
safety.versionsHint: Each version is a complete, verified copy of the catalogue (ratings, edits, moments, albums…). Photos are not here: they stay in the originals.
safety.invalid: The catalogue has problems: restore a version.
safety.catalogHint: Export saves a verified copy of the catalogue elsewhere (e.g. another disk). Import replaces this project's catalogue with an exported one — the current one is kept first.
safety.imported: Catalogue imported. The previous one was kept in versions.
safety.restored: Version restored. The previous catalogue was kept in versions.
safety.confirmRestore: Replace the current catalogue with this version? The current one is kept first (you can go back).
safety.confirmImport: Replace this project's catalogue with the chosen file? The current one is kept first (you can go back).
safety.toastUnclean: The previous session did not end properly. The catalogue was checked: nothing was lost.
safety.toastRestored: The catalogue was damaged and was restored from the last valid version.
safety.toastReconnected_one: Disk connected: {{count}} photo is available again.
safety.toastReconnected_other: Disk connected: {{count}} photos are available again.
safety.toastUnavailable: Originals unavailable: {{offline}} offline, {{missing}} missing. References were kept.
safety.photoOffline: Original offline: its disk is not connected. The reference was kept; connect the disk to edit or export.
safety.photoMissing: Original missing: the file is no longer where it was. Locate it to relink.

delete.question: What should happen?
delete.catalogHint: Files stay where they are, untouched. Ratings and edits of these photos leave the project.
delete.trashHint: Files go to the system trash (recoverable from there) and leave the catalogue. The import backup copy is never touched.
delete.understand_one: I understand that {{count}} original goes to the trash.
delete.understand_other: I understand that {{count}} originals go to the trash.
delete.removed_one: {{count}} photo removed from the catalogue (file kept).
delete.removed_other: {{count}} photos removed from the catalogue (files kept).
delete.trashed: {{count}} moved to the trash; {{failed}} refused (kept in catalogue).

privacy.hint: Everything stays on this computer. Here you can delete what the application generated about this job. Originals are never deleted.
privacy.cacheHint: Thumbnails, previews and already rendered edits of this project. They are generated again when needed (thumbnails start right away).
privacy.cacheCleared: Cache cleared: {{count}} files ({{size}}). Thumbnails are being generated again.
privacy.peopleHint: Deletes the people, names and face signatures (biometric data) of this project. Only the face boxes used by the selection (closed eyes, expressions) remain. Older catalog versions under “Versions” keep them until replaced; to delete everything, delete the project.
privacy.confirmPeople: Delete all people, names and face signatures of this project? Person assignments are lost.
privacy.projectHint: Closes the project and moves the project folder (catalog, edits, cache, faces, versions) to the system Trash, where it can be recovered. Originals and exports stay where they are. Refused if any original is inside the project folder.
privacy.confirmProject: Move the project “{{name}}” to the Trash? The original photos are not deleted.

uiError.title: An error occurred in the interface
uiError.body: Your decisions and edits were already saved in the catalog. The error was written to the application log (without paths or personal data). Reload the interface to continue.

lightroom.hint: Best 5★, Alternative 3★, Review 2★ — in .xmp files Lightroom reads
lightroom.title: Ratings for Lightroom
lightroom.how: For each RAW a .xmp file with the same name is created next to it with the stars. Lightroom reads them automatically on import; if the photos are already in Lightroom: select → Metadata → Read Metadata from Files.
lightroom.notCatalog: A .lrcat catalog is not generated: it is a private, undocumented Adobe format, and a generated catalog could fail to open or be damaged. .xmp files are the path Adobe supports.
lightroom.keepUserStars: Keep the stars I already gave (they win over the suggestion)
lightroom.applyInApp: Also apply these stars in PFF ProMaster (only to photos without stars)
lightroom.safety: RAW files are never changed. DNG, JPEG and TIFF get no .xmp (Lightroom only reads the rating from inside these files, which we never change). An existing .xmp only has its rating changed; a copy is kept (.xmp.pff-original).
lightroom.updated_one: {{count}} .xmp already existed: only the rating changed (copy kept).
lightroom.updated_other: {{count}} .xmp already existed: only the rating changed (copies kept).
lightroom.inApp_one: Stars applied to {{count}} photo in PFF ProMaster.
lightroom.inApp_other: Stars applied to {{count}} photos in PFF ProMaster.
lightroom.notRaw_one: {{count}} photo is not RAW (DNG/JPEG/TIFF…): no .xmp — use PFF ProMaster's stars or export.
lightroom.notRaw_other: {{count}} photos are not RAW (DNG/JPEG/TIFF…): no .xmp — use PFF ProMaster's stars or export.
lightroom.unavailable_one: {{count}} original unavailable (disk disconnected?): connect it and repeat.
lightroom.unavailable_other: {{count}} originals unavailable (disk disconnected?): connect it and repeat.
lightroom.next: In Lightroom: import the RAW folder (the .xmp files are read automatically) or, for photos already imported, Metadata → Read Metadata from Files.
